text:
nina_csm: Quick thread to nail down EBR for Crestline Bank. Goals: health snapshot, renewal risk heatmap, enablement plan, and exec asks. Who takes what?

omar_sales: I can own renewal posture + outreach slide. Need a clear ask: credit? SLA? Which execs to call out?

nina_csm: Call out CFO + Head of Payments. Ask = 30-day remediation plan + 1-month usage credit.

priya_pd: I'll craft product impact slide and short demo script (15m). Need top 3 customer scenarios from CS.

elly_eng: I'll add a one-slide tech appendix: SSO status + infra notes. ETA tomorrow.

sam_ops: I'll audit billing incidents and confirm if credits applied. Will post confirmation to thread by EOD.

ops_bot: Reminder: EBR template: https://redwood.app/internal/ebr-template. Include owners, due dates, customer quote, appendix.

omar_sales: Action list: renewal slide -> omar, demo/script -> priya, health metrics -> nina, infra -> elly, billing confirm -> sam.

nina_csm: Risk flags: 1) invoice lag (finance), 2) SSO entitlement gap (integration), 3) low DAU among payment admins. We'll show trend + mitigation per risk.

priya_pd: For DAU metric, prefer 30/60/90 breakdown. Nina, can you export that from CRM?

nina_csm: Yep pulling 30/60/90 and activation funnel. Will upload link when ready.

elly_eng: SSO note: two customers hit expired certs; cert rotation in progress. Will include ETA and rollback runbook.

sam_ops: Billing: finance applied credit for invoice #BR-449 last week. I'll add proof of credit tx.

priya_pd: Demo will show payments flow + admin console. Keeping it non-technical for execs; include appendix for eng.

omar_sales: I'll draft exec asks: 1) Approve usage credit, 2) Commit to onboarding sweeps, 3) Approve extended support window for migration. Posting v1 short bullets soon.

nina_csm: Can we run a dry run Fri 9am? Need all slides in drive by Thu 4pm.

ops_bot: Readiness check in 48h: owners? YES. links? PARTIAL. exec asks? PARTIAL. Please update.

elly_eng: Uploaded infra appendix: https://redwood.app/drive/ebr/crestline/infra_appendix.pdf

sam_ops: Billing evidence uploaded: https://redwood.app/drive/ebr/crestline/billing_credit.pdf

priya_pd: Demo script uploaded to drive. Requesting one product SME rehearsal Thu 10am. @elly_eng can you join?

elly_eng: Happy to rehearse Thu 10am.

omar_sales: Exec bullets (v0): 1) Finance credit confirmed (sam_ops). 2) Workshop for power users scheduled (nina_csm). 3) SSO cert rotation timeline and owner (elly_eng).

nina_csm: I'll assemble final slide order and post deck link by Thu 4pm. If anything changes paste a one-liner here. :raised_hands:
